name: accessibility-evidence-engine
description: Evidence-based accessibility investigations for Playwright flows.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/schemas packages/playwright packages/observers packages/judges packages/reporter packages/cli
scripts.check: tsc -b --pretty false packages/core packages/schemas packages/playwright packages/observers packages/judges packages/reporter packages/cli
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test packages/schemas/dist/validator.test.js packages/playwright/dist/index.test.js packages/observers/dist/index.test.js packages/judges/dist/index.test.js packages/reporter/dist/index.test.js packages/cli/dist/config-validation.test.js packages/cli/dist/index.test.js
